2. **Write Unit Tests for the `exportCSV(cards:)` Function:**

### Implementation

#### Code Implementation

```swift
import Foundation

public enum CSVParser {
    // ... existing code ...

    public static func exportCSV(cards: [(front: String, back: String, note: String?)]) -> Data {
        var csvRows = ["front,back,note"]
        
        for card in cards {
            let frontEscaped = escapeField(card.front)
            let backEscaped = escapeField(card.back)
            let noteEscaped = card.note.map { escapeField($0) } ?? ""
            
            let row = "\(frontEscaped),\(backEscaped),\(noteEscaped)"
            csvRows.append(row)
        }
        
        return Data(csvRows.joined(separator: "\n").utf8)
    }

    private static func escapeField(_ field: String) -> String {
        if field.contains(",") || field.contains("\"") || field.contains("\n") {
            let escapedField = field.replacingOccurrences(of: "\"", with: "\"\"")
            return "\"\(escapedField)\""
        }
        return field
    }
}
```

        3""
        """
        
        let csvData = CSVParser.exportCSV(cards: cards)

    }
}

import Foundation

public enum CSVParser {}

public extension CSVParser {
    static func parseImportPreview(
        data: Data,
        existingCards: [(front: String, back: String)],
        remainingCapacity: Int?
    ) -> [CSVRowStatus] {
        return parseImportRows(
            data: data,
            existingCards: existingCards,
            remainingCapacity: remainingCapacity
        ).map(\.status)
    }

    static func parseImportRows(
        data: Data,
        existingCards: [(front: String, back: String)],
        remainingCapacity: Int?
    ) -> [ParsedCSVRow] {
        guard let text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else {
            return [
                ParsedCSVRow(
                    sourceLine: 1,
                    front: "",
                    back: "",
                    note: nil,
                    status: .invalidEncoding,
                    normalizedKey: ""
                )
            ]
        }

        let parsedRows = parseRows(from: text)
        if parsedRows.isEmpty {
            return []
        }

        let existingKeys = Set(existingCards.map { normalizeKey(front: $0.front, back: $0.back) })
        var seenInFile: Set<String> = []
        var acceptedCount = 0

        return parsedRows.map { row in
            let frontRaw = row.fields[safe: 0] ?? ""
            let backRaw = row.fields[safe: 1] ?? ""
            let front = frontRaw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
            let back = backRaw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
            let note = row.fields.count > 2 ? row.fields[2] : nil
            let normalized = normalizeKey(front: front, back: back)

            let status = classifyRow(
                fields: row.fields,
                isWellFormed: row.isWellFormed,
                front: front,
                back: back,
                normalizedKey: normalized,
                existingKeys: existingKeys,
                seenInFile: &seenInFile,
                remainingCapacity: remainingCapacity,
                acceptedCount: acceptedCount
            )

            if case .ok = status {
                acceptedCount += 1
            }

            return ParsedCSVRow(
                sourceLine: row.sourceLine,
                front: front,
                back: back,
                note: note,
                status: status,
                normalizedKey: normalized
            )
        }
    }

    static func parseImportRowsWithDetails(
